question: Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:**"A bitter pill to swallow"**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e., **"A difficult truth to accept."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"A bitter pill to swallow"** refers to something unpleasant or difficult to accept. (स्वीकार करना कठिन सत्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Losing the championship game was a bitter pill to swallow for the team.
 
 
• The phrase is often used when someone has to come to terms with a harsh reality or an uncomfortable truth.
 
• In this context, **"A bitter pill to swallow"** is metaphorical and does not refer to an actual pill or medicine.
